caveats: The human is simulated by the gold label: every pool resolution is treated as confirmed at the correct reason code. A real operator would reject some, and each rejection is a precedent that never exists — so this curve is an upper bound on what deposits can achieve.

Seven of nine exception classes are derivable from the evidence and already sit at 98-100% with no corpus at all, so the headline rate has little room to move. The counterparty subset is the part with headroom and is reported separately.
Precedent precision is approximated by reason-code agreement. A precedent of the right class can still be the wrong precedent.
